messages:
Carla_Nguyen: Heads up 10: we need to lock the timeline for the CloudScale marketplace launch. Target Wed 10/04 window. Confirm PR embargo time, landing push, marketplace activation, and SI docs. tagging @Olivia_Martin and @Priya_Singh for handoffs
Olivia_Martin: Draft PR ready. Waiting on partner quote and hero image. If we get both by Monday EOD we can keep Wed. Otherwise move to backup Fri.
Dan_Patel: Legal flagged the partner logo placement last review. Jen, any update from legal?
Jen_Kim: Legal okayed the pack minus one tertiary mark. Ask: remove the small emblem from the hero. Once updated, I'll sign off PR.
Priya_Singh: SI onboarding guide uploaded to staging: https://redwood.internal/docs/marketplace/cloudscale-integration. Need a tech reviewer for the deployment snippet and pipeline names.
Marco_Lopez: I'll review the integration guide tomorrow AM. Quick note: sample deploy references old pipeline `deploy-prod-v1` 12; should be `cs-deploy-prod`. I'll push a patch.
Carla_Nguyen: Ops needs a definitive publish minute so CDN purge and monitor hooks are scheduled. Can we set a precise minute?
ops-bot: Available deploy window Wed 09:30-11:30 PT. Please confirm desired publish minute for scheduling.
mktg-bot: Recommend cadence: press 10:00 PT (embargo lift), blog 10:10 PT, marketplace listing 10:25 PT, partner social 10:35 PT. Set automated reminders? :bell:
Olivia_Martin: That cadence is fine editorially. We'll send embargoed PRs at 09:59 with watermark removed at 10:00. Partner quote must be in by Mon EOD.
Jen_Kim: I'll add a legal contact line in the PR doc for takedown and claim questions.
Dan_Patel: Ops checklist draft:
- 09:40 PT: Final staging snapshot and healthcheck
- 09:55 PT: CDN purge for assets
- 09:58 PT: Sitemap + robots update pushed
- 09:59 PT: Embargoed PRs queued
- 10:00 PT: Embargo lift + PR send
- 10:05 PT: Post-publish smoke test and health metrics check
- 10:10 PT: Blog publish
- 10:25 PT: Marketplace listing live
- 10:35 PT: Partner confirm and social
- 11:15 PT: Quick sync retrospective
Dan_Patel: Alert thresholds: if error rate >2% or latency p95 > 2s in first 15m, escalate and consider rollback.
Priya_Singh: I'll append a "post-launch rollback playbook" link to the SI guide and include vendor escalation steps.
Marco_Lopez: Integration docs cleaned up 10: I replaced deprecated flag `--fast-attach` with `--attach` and noted compatibility. Will push by 11:00 tomorrow.
Carla_Nguyen: Final asset checklist (confirm here so ops & PR have everything): PR copy, blog draft, landing HTML + hero image, logo pack (primary+mono), partner quote, SI integration guide (staging link), rollback/runbook, monitoring playbook.
Olivia_Martin: I'll distribute PR at 10:00 and own partner outreach. Also I'll circulate the final PR at Tue 16:00 PT for a 1-hour review window 13. Please comment inline.
Jen_Kim: Legal to standby for any intellectual property or claim issues. Phone number added in the release doc.
ops-bot: Reminder set: publish-runbook @ 2179000834 (30m before launch).
Dan_Patel: Ops follow-ups: collect sample API traces for the first 1000 requests for QA, smoke telemetry snapshot at 10:02 PT.
Priya_Singh: Can we add a 5-min grace check at 10:02 PT to verify telemetry? If metrics exceed thresholds, trigger rollback.
Marco_Lopez: Agreed. Also will tag example logs in the SI guide to help triage common errors.
Carla_Nguyen: Who will hit the distribution list exactly at 10:00? Olivia?
Olivia_Martin: Yes, I'll send and ping CloudScale PR. I'll also confirm marketplace activation at 10:30 PT.
Dan_Patel: Small but important: ensure "Supported models and limits" on landing matches marketplace listing exactly (version numbers and limits).
Priya_Singh: I'll post a diff of the model/limit fields by EOD for verification.
Carla_Nguyen: Great. If anything slips with legal or partner assets we fall back to Fri. Update the shared launch sheet: https://redwood.internal/launchsheets/cloudscale-gTM
Marco_Lopez: I'll PM once integration docs update is live.
Olivia_Martin: Final note 10: ensure partner social handles are included in the partner assets doc so tags are correct. I'll include in final PR packet.
Carla_Nguyen: Thanks team 10: stay in this thread for any last-minute changes. :rocket:
